title: Owner exceptions for one goatnet's mesh peers (ADR 1249 decision 7)
description: A peer listed here is excepted, for now, from the rule that every mesh peer has a recorded responsible person and organization. It is shown as an owner exception, with its reason, on every surface that shows owners; it is counted in goat_peer_owner_excepted and not in goat_peer_owner_unrecorded. The file lives in each goatnet's private overlay. An exception whose peer later gets a recorded owner, or leaves the mesh, is reported as stale so it can be removed.

peer_id.description: The NetBird peer id: stable across renames. The exception applies to this peer only.

name.description: The peer's name when the exception was granted. Informative; the id decides.

reason.description: Why the peer stays without a recorded owner for now. Shown beside it on every surface.

review_by.description: Optional. Set only by the operator; no tool fills it in.
